description: Merge multiple PDFs into one, in the given order. Document metadata is carried over from the first file. The output keeps the version of the inputs; when they mix PDF 2.0 and PDF 1.x the call is refused unless pdfVersion is given — "2.0" is an explicit conversion, and versions are never lowered. Pages are copied into a new document, so document-level information (tagged structure, XMP, attachments, AcroForm, bookmarks, etc.) is not carried over. Anything lost is reported in warnings; follow up on the output with attach_file / ensure_tagged / add_bookmarks / set_metadata as needed.

allowBreakingSignatures.description: When the target is digitally signed (detected via /ByteRange), the default is an error. Set true to proceed, accepting that the signatures become invalid.

inputPaths.description: Absolute paths of the PDFs to merge (in merge order, 2 or more).

outputPath.description: Destination file path (absolute). When omitted, a base64 string is returned instead.

pdfVersion.description: Version of the merged file. Omit it to keep the version of the inputs (the first input decides among PDF 1.x versions). Required when the inputs mix PDF 2.0 and PDF 1.x: "2.0" converts the merged file to PDF 2.0 (trailer /ID, Info metadata moved to XMP). "1.7" is refused when any input is PDF 2.0 — versions are never lowered.

returnBase64.description: When true, include a base64 string in the result in addition to saving.

name: merge_pdfs
title: Merge PDFs
